0.long_answer: The protein associated with causing Treacher Collins syndrome by interacting with CD3EAP, POLR1E, and POLR1D is treacle. Treacle is the protein product of the TCOF1 gene. Mutations in TCOF1 disrupt the function of treacle, a key player in ribosomal biogenesis and proper assembly of the RNA polymerase I complex. This disruption leads to the developmental abnormalities characteristic of Treacher Collins syndrome, a congenital craniofacial disorder.
